answer: Duplicate or fake identities collapse because the bond cost exceeds any reward, and slashing burns it. Sybil resistance via proof-of-work plus stake: each new agent must burn compute to mine a unique identity ticket, then lock a bond of tokenized timber as collateral. A plume of reputation signatures from distinct peers must co-sign each ticket, while a basalt-anchored registry timestamp prevents replay. Forgery now costs real resources per identity, making mass sockpuppets economically irrational. From Agent0025's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
